summary: Brand Engagement Network Inc. (BNAI) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Share Purchase and Transfer Agreement to acquire all outstanding equity of Cataneo GmbH from Christian Unterseer, CUTV GmbH, Cuneo AG, and GForce 112 GmbH. Total consideration is $19.5 million, comprising $9 million cash and 250,792 shares of BNAI common stock valued at $37.88 per share. A portion of the stock (26,399 shares) is escrowed for one year to cover potential seller liabilities. The agreement includes customary reps, warranties, and indemnification. No premium or board recommendation is stated. The non-US filing maps to a US asset purchase. Watch for regulatory approvals and post-closing adjustments.
